name: open-finance
description: Free, citable financial data for comps and DCF work: SEC EDGAR XBRL financials and filings, FRED Treasury yields, market prices and beta. No paid data subscription needed.

sec_user_agent.title: SEC contact (User-Agent)
sec_user_agent.description: Your name and email, e.g. "Jane Doe jane@example.com". SEC requires automated clients to identify themselves; sent only to sec.gov. Can also be set with the OPEN_FINANCE_SEC_USER_AGENT environment variable.
